en: Black‑and‑white view over a small European town with a stone arch bridge in the foreground crossing a shallow river. Along the riverbank are telegraph poles with many ceramic insulators, and a few people appear to be walking or wading in the water. On the far side of the river stand villas and townhouses with steep tiled roofs and half‑timbered gables, behind which rise larger institutional buildings. At the right is a church with a Baroque-style tower topped by a dome and cross. In the background are rolling fields and a smokestack on a hill, suggesting a semi‑industrial rural town. The image has the framing and composition typical of an early 20th‑century postcard, but no visible printed text on the front.
